title: Medieval Chaos
description:
Save Your Kingdom. Survive the Chaos.Face thousands of monsters in a fast-paced pixel art action roguelite. Can you endure the unforgiving landscapes and the deadly creatures that roam them Find out in this intense and endlessly replayable adventure.

Features• Earn experience quickly as you battle through endless waves of enemies

• Unlock new and powerful skills as your character levels up

• Full controller support for a seamless experience

• Combine weapons and shields to create unique combat builds

• Choose from a diverse cast of characters

• Play as more than 10 unlockable heroes

• Over 100 hours of replayability through progression and randomness

• Explore more than 30 distinct and challenging maps

Merge. Slay. Repeat.Medieval Chaos is a pixel art roguelike focused on high action, unpredictable loadouts and fast build crafting. Fight swarms of enemies, unlock upgrades, and forge powerful combinations as you push through increasingly intense battles.

Weapon Merge SystemCombine swords, spells, bows and unconventional weapons to create stronger hybrid tools mid run. Each merge opens new strategies and explosive results.

Endless Enemy WavesSurvive relentless hordes in constantly shifting arenas. Dodge, strike and grow stronger as the pressure increases.

Chaos Every Time You PlayProcedural maps, randomized upgrades and dynamic encounters ensure that each run feels fresh and entirely different.

For Fans OfVampire Survivors, Brotato, Soulstone Survivors, 20 Minutes Till Dawn
description_short: Slay, merge, and survive in this pixel roguelike battleground! Craft deadly weapons, fight endless hordes, and embrace medieval madness.
